lines.text: مانع اشتباهاست و ضانکه مرکز جرم قمر را است مقاطع منطقة البروج و همچنین مرکز هر یک از تداویر
lines.en: prevents confusion. And know that the center of the body of the Moon is the intersection of the ecliptic, and likewise the center of each of the epicycles

lines.text: خمسه متحیره را مداريست مقاطع منطقة البروج بدو نقطه متقابل که يکي راس باشد و آن
lines.en: of the five wandering planets has an orbit intersecting the ecliptic at two opposite points, one of which is the Head (ascending node), and that

lines.text: در کواکب علويه نقطه بود که چون مرکز تدوير ايشان از ان بگذرد در شمال منطقة البروج
lines.en: in the superior planets is the point such that when the center of their epicycle passes it, it is in the north of the ecliptic,

lines.text: بود و در زهره نقطه که چون مرکز تدوير او از ان بگذرد باوج متوجه شود و در
lines.en: and in Venus it is the point such that when the center of its epicycle passes it, it heads towards the apogee, and in

lines.text: عطارد و بحضيض و ديگري ذنب که آن در کواکب علويه نقطه بود که چون مرکز تدوير
lines.en: Mercury towards the perigee. And the other is the Tail (descending node), which in the superior planets is the point such that when the center of the epicycle

lines.text: ايشان از ان بگذرد و در جنوب منطقة البروج شود و در زهره نقطه بود که چون
lines.en: of them passes it, it is in the south of the ecliptic, and in Venus it is the point such that when

lines.text: مرکز تدوير ايشان از ان بگذرد و در جنوب منطقة البروج شود در عطارد و متوجه اوج و تفاوت
lines.en: the center of their epicycle passes it, it is in the south of the ecliptic, in Mercury, and heads towards the apogee. And the difference

lines.text: تعريف اين دو نقطه در علويه و سفليه بنا بر نکته است که در کتب هيات معلوم ميشود
lines.en: in the definition of these two points in the superior and inferior planets is based on a point that becomes known in astronomy books.

lines.text: و بيان آن اينجا لايق نيست و ايضا هر يک از او پر اين کواکب در اين امر بجهت عدم دوام
lines.en: And its explanation is not appropriate here. And also, each of the epicycles of these planets in this matter, due to the lack of permanence

lines.text: جرم ايشانست بر يک مدار چه گاهي بر مدار مرکز تدوير اند گاهي طرف شمالي ان و گاهي
lines.en: of their body on one orbit, for sometimes they are on the orbit of the center of the epicycle, sometimes on its northern side, and sometimes

lines.text: در طرف جنوبي ان بخلاف قمر که با مرکز تدوير خود دايما متحد المدار است و جوزهر آن
lines.en: on its southern side, unlike the Moon, which is always on the same orbit as the center of its epicycle. And its node

lines.text: خمسه متحيره را سير يست مستقيم هر يک نقطه شخصي اند از ممثلات که بحرکت فلک البروج
lines.en: of the five wandering planets has a direct motion. Each is a specific point of the equants that by the motion of the sphere of the zodiac

lines.text: متحرکند و مقدار ان حرکت هر شبانروزي هشت ثالثه است و در بعضي تقاويم نامه
lines.en: moves, and the amount of that motion every day and night is eight thirds, and in some ephemerides

lines.text: موضع الراس هر يک از خمسه متحيره در اول هر ماهي از ماههاي جلالي بر سر جدول آن
lines.en: the position of the Head of each of the five wandering planets at the beginning of each month of the Jalali months at the top of its table

lines.text: تقويم انکوکب ثبت کنند اگر مسافت صالح بوده باشد والا در صفحه اسيري بر سر جدول
lines.en: of the ephemeris of that planet is recorded, if the space is suitable, otherwise on the left page at the top of the table

lines.text: هر کوکب که بجهت نظرات انکوکب يا قمر کشيده باشند ثبت کنند بچهار رقم يکي برج
lines.en: of each planet that they have drawn for the aspects of that planet or the Moon, they record it with four digits: one for the sign,

lines.text: دوم درجه سيم دقيقه چهارم ثانيه بجهت آنست که حرکت جوزهران کواکب در مدت
lines.en: the second for the degree, the third for the minute, the fourth for the second, because the motion of the nodes of the planets in the period

lines.text: يکسال شمسي بدقيقه نميرسد پس ثبت ان بدون ثانيه در اول هر ماه عبث باشد
lines.en: of one solar year does not reach a minute, so recording it without seconds at the beginning of each month would be vain.

lines.text: و موضع ذنب هر کوکب برج هفتم موضع راس انکوکب باشد همان اجزا چنانکه موضع
lines.en: And the position of the Tail of each planet is the seventh sign from the position of the Head of that planet, with the same parts, just as the position

summary.headline: Planetary Nodes and Ephemerides
summary.text: Discussion of the lunar and planetary nodes, defining the Head (ascending node) and Tail (descending node) by their positions relative to the ecliptic and epicycles, with distinctions for superior planets, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon. It explains the direct motion of the five wandering planets’ nodes, their daily movement, and how their positions are recorded in Jalali-month ephemerides.
